translations.web: ‘Call to me, and I will answer you, and will show you great and difficult things, which you don’t know.’
translations.bsb: Call to Me, and I will answer and show you great and unsearchable things you do not know.
translations.kjv: Call unto me, and I will answer thee, and shew thee great and mighty things, which thou knowest
translations.asv: Call unto me, and I will answer thee, and will show thee great things, and difficult, which thou knowest not.
